chapter: 11. Spinal Cord Disorders, Myelopathy & Cauda Equina Syndromes
countBasis: Distinct high-yield diagnostic and treatment decisions; not official NEET-SS weighting. Avoid repeating cord-pattern localization already tested in Chapter 1. Reassess gaps and redundancy during final review.

Investigate and treat epidural infection with neurologic deterioration urgently
Recognize spontaneous or anticoagulant-associated epidural hematoma
Manage degenerative cervical myelopathy by severity/progression rather than incidental stenosis alone
Investigate syringomyelia causes and select etiologic management

crossChapterBoundaries: Chapter 1 already tests Brown-Sequard, anterior cord and syringomyelic localization; this chapter tests etiologic investigation, emergency sequencing and management.
Chapter 6 covers MS/NMOSD/MOG diagnostic criteria; here lesion-pattern interpretation supports the broader myelopathy differential without repeating those criteria MCQs.
Chapter 5 covers CNS pathogens and Chapter 9/10 peripheral mimics; explanations remain standalone when relevant.
requiredFinalReview: Verify current MSCC, CES, spinal infection and acute injury guidelines
Distinguish evidence-qualified recommendations from universal rules
Review all options and exact management sequencing
Validate, install additively, verify runtime preservation and commit/push
